read: current organizer managers get and list one contact's notes (organizerId equality) while their account is not deleted; the Host person page reads the newest
migrationNotes: Notes are organizer-scoped operational memory, author-stamped, and excluded from exportOrganizerContacts without an opt-in path.
Existing contacts require no backfill because notes are separate append-only records with optimistic edits.
rulesTestNames: lets managers read their contact notes and keeps outreach and manual-tag vocabularies callable-only
